inputs.closed_form: the pricing model's run-space calibrated expectations, mixed over rating uncertainty and scheduled length (distribution.closedForm)
inputs.simulator: the run model's own expectations (level-unbiased), rating uncertainty drawn per simulated game
inputs.simulator_on_calibrated_inputs: the calibrated expectations (the first version; double-counts the home side's last-inning effect)

justification: the simulator loses accuracy on full-game markets against the closed form (comparisons in uncertainty), so it does not price them; it remains the only first-five engine (CBX-SIMULATOR-F5)

title: Which engine prices full-game markets

justification: the closed form is not worse on any full-game market and better where the intervals separate; it prices every full-game market
